items.proposed: MGMT: exploratory_correlative (not eligibility); not a selection biomarker
items.reason: Entry only requires that 'MGMT methylation status must be available, or able to be determined'; no MGMT status is required, so this is not an entry requirement on the biomarker and is not molecular selection.

Exclusion 'The presence of IDH mutation prior to enrollment' effectively requires IDH-wildtype; record also says 'Glioblastoma Multiforme (WHO Grade IV)' (historical), and when both apply the manual says code cns5.

note: MGMT 'status must be available' is testing, not selection (consistent with D31-A8). cns5 rests on treating an IDH-mutation exclusion as an IDH-wildtype requirement; XL may prefer historical if the exclusion is not read as a requirement.
